lesson: Not a defect (evidence docs/specs/delegation-boundary.md:79): False contract interpretation: exact approved files do not authorize following a baseline symlink. Existing no-follow topology refuses mode120000 and linked/reparse ancestors to preserve scope confinement. Accepted narrowed scope does not require supporting symlink mutation; changing this would weaken the retained boundary. — raised as "LEAN-AC-4: Narrowed delegation: `forge delegate --scope` is a proper-subset narrowing feature, exact approved files are valid subset members, no flag keeps full"
